import json, urllib.request
cfg=json.load(open('/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/.claude/database/dc-platform.json'))
base=cfg['base_url'].rstrip('/')
token=cfg['token']
codes=[
'dev-20261016-006','dev-20261016-007','dev-20261016-008','dev-20261016-009',
'dev-20261016-010','dev-20261016-011','dev-20261016-012','dev-20261016-019',
'dev-20261016-013','dev-20261016-014','dev-20261016-015','dev-20261016-016',
'dev-20261016-017','dev-20261016-018']
for c in codes:
    req=urllib.request.Request(base+f'/api/v1/dev-sessions/{c}/full', headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {token}'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=40) as r:
        d=json.load(r)
    st=d['state_json']
    s4=st.get('stage4_spark') or {}
    files=d.get('files') or []
    names=[]
    nonempty=0
    if isinstance(files, list):
        for f in files:
            if isinstance(f, dict):
                name=f.get('name') or f.get('path') or f.get('filename')
                content=f.get('content') or f.get('text') or ''
                names.append(name)
                if str(content).strip():
                    nonempty+=1
            else:
                names.append(str(f)[:40])
    elif isinstance(files, dict):
        names=list(files)
        nonempty=sum(1 for v in files.values() if str(v).strip())
    extra=[k for k in st.keys() if k.startswith('stage') or k in ('strict_mode','owner_boundary')]
    print(f"{c}\tcur={st.get('current_stage')}\textra={extra}\ts4={list(s4) if isinstance(s4, dict) else type(s4)}\tfiles={len(names)} nonempty~{nonempty}")
